snippet.title: Taste of the Wind — 1-Minute Gameplay Demo | Now Playable on Steam Next Fest 🍜
snippet.description:
Taste of the Wind is a cozy indie game about running a small Chinese restaurant.
Cook, serve, and manage your restaurant — every dish carries a story, and every day feels alive.
🎮 Play the free demo now on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest!
#TasteOfTheWind #IndieGame #SteamNextFest
